name: Anantara Maia Seychelles Villas
positioning: All-villa beach resort on a small peninsula at Anse Louis on Mahe's west coast, with Bill Bensley-designed villas, each with a private infinity pool and a dedicated Villa Host
best_for: Couples who want a private villa with its own infinity pool by the beach
Families wanting beach villas, a kids' program and a kids' spa menu

facts.text: The resort is on the West Coast Road at Anse Louis on Mahe Island, Seychelles.
The resort sits on a petite peninsula on Mahe's southwest coast, separating Anse Louis and Anse Boileau.
The resort's private villas edge porcelain sands and are framed by thirty acres of forest.
Villas are located either on the beach or on the hilltop, overlooking the secluded coastline and the Indian Ocean.
The villas have thatched roofs and are all identical in size and layout; they differ in their views.
Peninsula Ocean View Pool Villas sit on the edge of the peninsula with open views of the Indian Ocean.
Spa therapists come from Thailand and Bali.
The resort offers yoga and wellness sessions, Technogym workouts and a padel court.
There is no kids' club, but the Very Important Kids Program includes supervised water sports, cooking and painting, and the spa has a kids' wellness menu.
With the Dining by Design concept, guests can choose from a range of gourmet cuisines with a choice of backdrops.
Scuba diving can be organised with a nearby preferred dive centre, and the resort can arrange day trips to neighbouring islands.
Guests can walk to Anse Boileau, a small fishing village a few minutes away with a local market and a Catholic church.

highlights.text: The villas were designed by Bill Bensley and combine rustic hammered copper with elegant soft furnishings.
Each villa has a private infinity pool, a sun deck and an outdoor sunken bathtub.
Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host, assigned to that villa only and reachable 24/7 by WhatsApp.
The Anantara Spa has open-air treatment pavilions and offers The Maia Signature Massage, a long-stroke, stretch-heavy treatment developed for the resort.
With the Marine Conservation Society Seychelles, the resort runs a long-term sea turtle monitoring program on Anse Louis beach, a nesting beach for Hawksbill and Green turtles.

considerations.text: Hilltop villas have more sweeping ocean views, while those nearer sea level see more foliage and less water but have direct beach access.
Room rates are subject to a sustainable environmental fee per villa per night, invoiced separately.
The resort is approximately 35 minutes from the international airport by car, depending on traffic.
